headline: FCC clears SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million orbital data-center satellites
bottomLine: The FCC conditionally approved SpaceX's 1-million-satellite orbital data-center plan; Neuralink said the FDA cleared a pivotal brain-implant trial; Nvidia paused server shipments to four Southeast Asian countries. Hot inflation makes a December Fed hike the base case.

portfolio.title: FCC conditionally approves SpaceX's 1 million-satellite Starmind data-center plan
portfolio.brief: The FCC authorized up to 1 million solar-powered Starmind AI-compute satellites, conditional on backup radio links and more safety data for higher orbits, with a 2040 deployment deadline.
portfolio.impact: Regulatory cover for moving AI compute off strained grids, but the conditions and 2040 deadline make this long-dated option value, not near-term revenue; no first-launch date was reported.
portfolio.action: Ask SpaceX investor relations when the first Starmind satellites fly and what the higher-orbit conditions mean for launch cadence, before the Dec 8 share unlock.

portfolio.title: Perplexity caps agent use on Pro plans while Amazon's suit over its agent continues
portfolio.brief: Perplexity added weekly agent-usage limits to paid Pro plans. Amazon is still pressing its suit over the agent before a divided judge, and is reportedly in talks to lift its block on Meta's Muse agent.
portfolio.impact: Metering shows agent compute is costly and now being monetized. A Meta-Amazon deal would give Perplexity a template for retail access; losing in court would shut it out.
portfolio.action: Ask Perplexity's CEO this week whether it is negotiating its own Amazon access deal like Meta's, and what it will do if the court rules against it.

thesis.title: Oil rebounds on Hormuz incidents as UK briefs industry on £35bn small-reactor plan
thesis.brief: Oil rose on Strait of Hormuz incidents and renewed Middle East attacks threatening Gulf supply recovery. In the UK, SGE SMR briefed industry on a £35bn plan for 14 reactors across three sites.
thesis.impact: Repeated chokepoint scares keep the case for nuclear alive, and the UK plan is the state-backed SMR order our call needs. It is still proposed, not contracted.

thesis.title: Bitcoin falls below $58K as ETFs lose $453M in a day and a Fed hike nears
thesis.brief: Bitcoin fell below $58,000 after stronger US growth and hotter inflation; US spot bitcoin ETFs had $453M of net outflows Wednesday. A December Fed hike was already the market's base case.
thesis.impact: Our thesis needs money that is too loose; a likely hike into an AI selloff cuts against it, and ETF outflows show buyers are not yet treating tighter policy as debasement.

regulation.title: Nvidia tells partners to halt AI server shipments to four Southeast Asian countries
regulation.brief: Nvidia told partners to pause server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia, per the FT; Dell and Supermicro told buyers orders won't ship. A new US rule requires licenses for certain advanced chips.
regulation.impact: Aims to keep AI chips out of China but strands Southeast Asian data-center builds, the latest export-control shock. Super Protocol's NVIDIA-linked deployments are exposed if licensing widens.
regulation.next: Licenses decide when shipments resume; no timeline reported
regulation.action: Ask Super Protocol by Monday whether any NVIDIA-based deployment or partner depends on servers bound for these four countries, and what its fallback is.

regulation.title: House committee advances Strategic Bitcoin Reserve bill with 20-year lock
regulation.brief: The bill codifying Trump's Strategic Bitcoin Reserve cleared committee and is eligible for a House vote; Section 5 holds federally acquired bitcoin for 20 years. The 119th Congress adjourns in coming weeks.
regulation.impact: A statutory reserve would be the clearest sovereign Bitcoin signal yet, but without floor action before adjournment the bill dies. Treat it as a marker, not a catalyst.

regulation.title: Warren, Van Hollen urge SEC to rescind Regulation Crypto and innovation exemption
regulation.brief: Sens. Warren and Van Hollen sent two letters to SEC Chair Atkins demanding he rescind the innovation exemption and Regulation Crypto, which cover crypto and tokenized securities.
regulation.impact: Crypto's opening rests on SEC exemptions, not statute, so a change in control could reverse it and institutions may wait for law. That complicates our call that the CLARITY Act unlocks them.
regulation.next: SEC reply awaited; no date reported

frontier.title: Engineered molecular glue restores chromosome connections in aging mouse eggs
frontier.brief: Researchers engineered a protein system that restored normal chromosome connections in aging mouse eggs, per STAT. The result is in mouse eggs only.
frontier.impact: An early egg-aging result that could one day improve IVF outcomes. It is preclinical, with no human test and no peer-review status stated, so treat it as a lead, not a result.

frontier.title: New hypothesis says dark energy may come from known Standard Model physics
frontier.brief: A hypothesis reported by Phys.org and others says dark energy may emerge from known particle and nuclear physics, with no new physics needed.
frontier.impact: If it holds, it weakens the case for exotic vacuum-energy explanations. For now it is a theoretical proposal with no test or replication reported.
